artworks.title: Sebastopol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a broad river or bay leading to a city on its shores. The waterway is bordered by buildings and infrastructure, with hills in the distance. The cityscape features various buildings of older architectural styles. Nearby terrain is rocky with sparse vegetation leading to the water's edge. The image is in sepia tones, giving a timeless quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Remains of the Malakoff Tower
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective of a dilapidated structure resembling a fort. Large wooden logs and debris are scattered in the foreground, leading the eye towards the stonework of the fortification. At the top are makeshift buildings, including a wooden lookout post and a tent-like structure. A solitary figure stands to the right. The color palette is a monochrome sepia, enhancing the aged appearance of the photograph.

artworks.title: The Arsenal
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a construction site with large stone structures. There are pathways and patches of grass throughout the area. In the background, there is a body of water with a horizontal structure visible. Beyond the water, there are constructed buildings along the horizon. The color palette is muted with sepia and earthy tones, giving the image an aged appearance. The overall impression is one of industrious progress against a calm backdrop.

artworks.title: The Arsenal
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a construction area near water, with a distant landscape in the background. In the center, there is a tall wooden framework and scattered building materials. On the right, there are long, low buildings along the waterfront. The color palette is primarily sepia, giving a vintage appearance. The image has a photographic style, with muted tones of browns and beiges.

artworks.title: Fortification above Balaclava Harbor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape viewed from a high vantage point. The horizon is at the top of the image, with a barren hill meeting the sky. The foreground features a steep hill with white rooftop structures resembling tents or small encampments. A winding path leads to a stone tower on a rocky outcrop. The landscape transitions into an open area descending into a narrow bay surrounded by cliffs. The sea is visible on the left side with a textured surface due to the breeze. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving a timeless feel to the scenery.

artworks.title: Hutted Camp with Balaclava Harbor in Distance
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image features a valley surrounded by rocky hills. There are box-like structures with pitched roofs in the forefront, followed by conical tents extending towards a body of water with sailing ships. The horizon is high, framed by hilltops, and there is a tower or structure on one peak. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Gun Battery
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This image shows a historical military fortification with two large cannons, partially concealed behind protective woven mats and sandbags. The materials in the scene include rope, wood, and earth, with mats made from thick ropes secured over sticks or logs. The walls behind the cannons are constructed from logs, earth, and stones, with woven structures for reinforcement. The focus is on the fort's construction details with a monochromatic sepia tone giving it an antique look. The texture of the woven materials and stonework is detailed, emphasizing the fortification's rugged design.

artworks.title: Gun Battery
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a military fortification with cannons. The scene shows an outdoor area with several large cannons surrounded by military supplies and debris. The landscape is rugged, with various materials like wooden planks, sandbags, barrels, and metal objects scattered around. Behind the cannons, there are wicker and earthworks walls for fortification, suggesting a setting prepared for heavy artillery engagements.

artworks.title: The Mamelon Vert
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape with military fortifications. There are soldiers among complex trench systems with wicker and sandbags. The horizon is high in the image, with a flat expanse of land stretching across it. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, emphasizing the barren and utilitarian nature of the landscape.

artworks.title: Village of Kadikoi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a vast, barren landscape with a view from an elevated position. In the distance, the horizon line is defined by gentle, rolling hills. A road or path winds through the scene, leading the eye across the image. A clustered settlement of tents and small structures is nestled along the hillside, forming a busy village that stretches towards the hills. The buildings are arranged parallel to the winding road, which curves as it leads further into the scene. The coloration is predominantly light to dark browns and beige tones, typical of an arid or mountainous region, conveying a sense of desolation yet also intricate human activity amidst the natural terrain.

artworks.title: General View of Camp
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a military encampment from a slightly elevated point of view. The expansive field is covered with rows of tents extending into the distance. At the horizon, there are low hills under a clear sky. A group of men is standing on a grassy area in the foreground. The image has a sepia tone typical of early photography, with a soft focus capturing textures and details of the scene. The color palette consists mainly of browns and creams, creating a historical atmosphere. The arrangement of the tents shows order and uniformity, emphasizing the scale and organization of the camp.

artworks.title: Gun Battery
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a view of gun emplacements with cannons pointed towards a fort across a body of water. The horizon is low, almost blending with the fortress in the distance. The fort is positioned off-center to the right, showcasing its stone structure by the water. Two cannons are mounted on wooden platforms in the foreground, alongside a stack of cannonballs. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, giving it an aged look. The landscape is barren with minimal vegetation, suggesting a utilitarian military environment.

artworks.title: Remains of Stone Buildings
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a vast landscape. In the foreground, there are rocky ruins, followed by rows of dilapidated buildings in a grid-like pattern on overgrown land. In the distance, there is a large body of water, with land extending beyond it. Faint outlines of buildings are visible on the horizon. The sky above is pale and uniform. The color palette is mainly brown and beige.

artworks.title: View of Street with Soldiers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene. The shot is taken from ground level, providing a view of the architecture and street life. The horizon is located towards the upper left corner, revealing a body of water or distant land meeting the sky. Buildings line both sides of the street, with houses on the right featuring tiled roofs and weathered stone walls. The photograph is monochrome, giving a vintage atmosphere. People are seen walking on the dirt road and near the buildings. The street narrows in the distance, leading the eye towards the horizon, surrounded by houses and trees. More structures appear in the background, indicating the continuation of the street.

artworks.title: Valley of the Cemetery
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with scattered buildings and structures placed on the horizon, reflecting in a body of water. There are remnants of old stone buildings and ruins amidst patches of grass and sparse trees, with a winding dirt path leading into the distance. The image has an antique, muted palette with earthy tones of brown and cream.

artworks.title: Camp of the 17th Regiment
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with tents and structures arranged in an organized manner. The horizon is high in the composition with the land sloping upwards towards distant hills. A line of tents on the horizon stretches laterally. In the foreground, there is open ground with rocks and sparse vegetation, leading to wooden structures and tents in neat rows. The image is monochromatic with sepia tones dominating, giving a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Sebastopol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with scattered ruins and remnants of structures. The horizon is visible at the top, where land meets the sea stretching across the frame. In the distance, clusters of buildings are seen on the sloping terrain. The scene has a monochrome appearance with a vintage sepia tint. Various stone structures and debris are scattered throughout the landscape, leading to a central winding path. Close by, there are mounds of dirt and what seem to be building remains. In the background, there is the sea and a hint of a city skyline.

artworks.title: Ruined Buildings
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts an aerial view of a cityscape featuring a mixture of ruins and intact buildings. The horizon is located in the upper third of the image, showing a flat landscape extending into the distance. The scene is captured in sepia tones, creating a vintage look. The foreground shows rocky terrain leading to a combination of structures in varying states of repair, with more buildings in the distance. The background includes more structures and open land, adding depth to the historical scene.

artworks.title: Sebastopol, From Left Attack
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal town with a bay or harbor, buildings with stone walls and tiled roofs, rocky terrain, sparse vegetation, and water in the background. The town extends towards the horizon, where two large buildings are visible. The image has a monochromatic sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Sebastopol, View of Harbor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a body of water surrounded by hills. The foreground has rocky, barren terrain with remains of structures. Along the water's edge are various buildings, docks, and boats. The horizon features a strip of elevated land. The image has a monochromatic tone, possibly sepia, lending an antique look. The detailed elements suggest a focus on faithful documentation of the scene.

artworks.title: The Library, Sebastopol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene featuring a faded, sepia-toned photograph of a stone structure. In the forefront, there is a circular tower with arched openings and sculptural reliefs. Behind it, there is a large building with classical elements like columns and pilasters. Some parts of the building show damage, with sections bricked up. Bare trees line a path next to the building, suggesting a stark scene. The sky is a washed-out hue. There is no defined horizon visible, giving prominence to the structures in the composition. The monochromatic palette emphasizes the texture and aged quality of the buildings, highlighting their historical decay and grandeur.

artworks.title: Courtyard with Domed Building in Ruins
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This image shows a desolate landscape with crumbling stone buildings. A path lined with rubble fades into the distance. The sky is expansive above, with more ruined structures on the horizon. A domed structure on the left and a damaged building on the right are prominent features. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a vintage quality and emphasizing the decay of the architecture.

artworks.title: Church of Sts. Peter and Paul
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural view of an ancient temple-like structure taken from a low perspective. The structure features tall, fluted columns supporting an intricately designed pediment with a relief carving of a bird. In the foreground, there is a horse or mule-drawn cart with visible wooden wheels and harness. Surrounding the building are sparse bushes and a few trees, casting shadows on the temple. The photograph is in a monochrome sepia tone, adding a vintage atmosphere. The temple's weathered stones suggest age and exposure to the elements.

artworks.title: Street in Sebastopol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a deserted street lined with dilapidated buildings. Tree remains and rubble are scattered along the sidewalk. The sky dominates the scene and there are a few figures in the distance. The overall color palette is sepia-toned, giving the photo an aged look.
